presets.title: #5: the chaotic edge creeps into the block
presets.caption: Every 400,000th step over 10^9 steps, cells -349 to 2,250, fitted to your window (the label says how many cells and steps share a pixel): the fine texture on the left (the chaotic edge) slowly eats into the white block of 1s. Point at the edge and press z to open that moment at every step.

presets.title: #5 at 9·10^8: one bounce off the chaotic edge, every step
presets.caption: Not sampled: every step from 900,003,230 to 900,003,370, cells 1,730 to 1,790: the live edge at step 9·10^8. The head arrives from the right across the block of 1s, turns at the edge (cell 1,752) and leaves. Press w for its next visit, Space to play this one.

presets.title: #5 at 9·10^8: a deep visit (a carry into the edge)
presets.caption: Steps 902,498,900 to 902,503,150: the deepest of 120 visits after step 9·10^8. The head goes 356 cells into the edge (to cell 1,407) and back, 4,025 steps. Fitted to your window, so rows may be sampled (the label says); z on a row opens it at every step.

presets.title: #5: carry-like waves in the edge (constructed start)
presets.caption: Every step from a constructed configuration (the edge next to the block), all visited cells in view: the C waves zigzag into the edge. Scroll down (arrows, wheel) for later steps.

presets.title: #5: three trips (the "mid-run" card)
presets.caption: Steps 12,287 to 12,992 (bounces 54-57) of the blank-tape run, fitted to your window. The run starts at step 0; the view starts later (the label says so). If the label says the rows are sampled, press } to zoom time in, or z on a row for every step.

presets.title: #5: records rows
presets.caption: One row per new leftmost or rightmost cell, 10^8 steps.

presets.title: #17: walls (00 blue, 11 red) over 10^9 steps
presets.caption: Every 1,000,000th step over 10^9 steps, fitted to your window (64+ cells per pixel). Blue = how many 00 pairs, red = how many 11 pairs start in the pixel (log ramp; hover for exact counts). Blue dashed lines = epoch anchors.

presets.title: #17: walls over time, background removed
presets.caption: Every 500,000th step to 4.395·10^8, fitted to your window; orange = 2-blocks that are not the 10/01 background (hover for exact counts).

presets.title: #17: one slow-phase cycle
presets.caption: From the configuration at step 9,786,531 (constructed from the file) to step 10^7. Fit squeezes time, so rows are sampled (the label says every how many steps); press 1 for square pixels, or z on a row to open it at every step.

presets.title: #17: records view of the epochs
presets.caption: Records rows (one row per new leftmost or rightmost cell), fitted to your window. The card used every 48th record and 48 cells/px; here the zoom ladder is powers of two, and the label says which.

presets.title: #17 in Blaze colours, 10^9 steps
presets.caption: The whole run fitted, Blaze palette (orange = 1).

presets.title: #2 vs TM7: eating and draining
presets.caption: #2 (A) and its template TM7 (B) from the same constructed start S(L^4 1L1), every step. They are identical until A1 fires (0RF vs 0RC): the dashed line. d switches to the diff (orange = A bigger, cyan = B bigger); r gives records rows, which line the two machines up by their k-th record. Space plays; the tape strip shows both tapes.

presets.title: Bigfoot, the site's Explore look
presets.caption: 3 symbols: 1 grey, 2 white. Shift+S opens the bbchallenge view (Default / Explore / Blaze) drawn by the site's own code.

presets.title: Antihydra: records, right-edge frame
presets.caption: Records rows over 10^9 steps, each row shifted so its right edge is fixed.

presets.title: Example.v counter: records as a binary odometer
presets.caption: States C-F are unreachable (greyed in the table). Each records row is one more digit.
